name: Data Cleaning
description: Deterministic cleanup of CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL tables: trims whitespace, snake_case headers, standardizes nulls, dates (YYYY-MM-DD), numbers, emails, phone numbers and booleans, drops empty rows and duplicates. Returns cleaned data + change summary + self-QA report + sha256. Max 1MB / 20,000 rows per job.

data.description: CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL text, or an array of objects

deliverable: JSON: {summary, columns, columnTypes, output:{format,rows,data}, qa, sha256}

name: Data Transform
description: Convert between CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL and apply a pipeline of operations: rename, select, drop, cast, flatten nested JSON, filter, sort, concat, split, fill, limit. Deterministic, no LLM. Max 1MB / 20,000 rows per job.
deliverable: JSON: {summary, operationsLog, columns, output:{format,rows,data}, qa, sha256}

name: Data Validation
description: Data quality audit: validates rows against a column schema (type, required, unique, min/max, length, regex pattern, enum, composite keys) or auto-profiles when no schema is given. Returns quality score 0-100, error list with row numbers, per-column profile. Max 1MB / 20,000 rows per job.
deliverable: JSON: {summary:{valid,qualityScore,errorCount,...}, errorsByRule, errors[], profile, qa, sha256}
